subject: POC hands-on session — scheduling, access, and load-test window
messages:
From: Sophie Kramer <sophie.kramer@greenlinepay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Tan <michael.tan@greenlinepay.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC hands-on session — initial dates and questions

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Greenline is excited to move to a hands-on POC. We'd like to lock a full-day working session to walk through prompt review, routing experiments, and a short load validation. A few items up front:

- Proposed week: Sep 13–17 (preferred is Sep 15)
- Preferred mode: hybrid (25 onsite engineers + ~8 remote observers) — we can flip to fully virtual if that’s easier for you
- AV/room needs: projector + 2x HDMI inputs, a stable guest Wi‑Fi with NAT access to your sandbox (we can provide IP allowlist if needed)
- Recording: we may want recordings for our internal training — will you consent to recording/screenshots? Any forms we need to sign?
- Visitor on‑site requirements: any badge policy, NDA or background checks before entry?

Can you confirm availability for Sep 15 and a rough agenda (prompt review window, routing tests, and a 30‑minute load spike at the end we can coordinate)? I can share a visitor list and company PO if helpful.

Attachments: none on my end but happy to provide visitor CSV.

Thanks,
Sophie Kramer
Program Manager, Integrations
Greenline Payments
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Kramer <sophie.kramer@greenlinepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC hands-on session — initial dates and questions

Hi Sophie — great to hear, and Sep 15 mostly works for our team. A few notes and asks below so we can lock logistics: 

1) Mode & headcount
- Hybrid is fine. We can host 25 onsite (room capacity confirmed) + up to 12 remote seats for observers via our conference room Zoom. Please confirm final onsite headcount by Sep 1.

2) AV / network
- We have dual HDMI + AirPlay. For the sandbox access, the simplest path is to add a short-term CIDR to our testing VPC; alternatively you can use a laptop through guest Wi‑Fi and we’ll route requests through our staging proxy. If you prefer IP allowlisting, please include the ranges with the visitor list.

3) Recording & consent
- We can record the session for your internal use. We ask that recordings remain within your security boundaries and not be distributed. I’m attaching our standard recording-consent-form.docx — please sign and return.

4) Visitor policy
- Guest badges are required. We need a name + company + government ID number for building pass pre-clearance (see attached site-access-instructions.pdf). Please do NOT include sensitive PII in email; use the CSV attachment you referenced.

5) Agenda & load test
- Proposed half-day agenda: 9:00–12:00 prompt & routing review; 12:00–13:00 lunch; 13:00–15:00 guided hands-on prompts; 15:00–15:30 load validation (short spike, discussed below).
- Load test: we recommend a dry‑run 48 hours prior (Sep 13) between 14:00–15:00 PDT to validate concurrency and alerting. For the final spike on Sep 15 we’ll limit to a controlled 10‑minute window with our ops team on standby.

Marissa (cc) will coordinate the runbook and test windows; Dylan (cc) will validate AV/network constraints. If hybrid changes to fully virtual we can pivot and send preconfigured environment links and a curated prompt pack.

If Sep 15 is confirmed, I’ll send a calendar invite with a checklist and the recording consent attached.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Principal Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: recording-consent-form.docx, site-access-instructions.pdf
From: Sophie Kramer <sophie.kramer@greenlinepay.com>

Thanks Hannah — that all looks good. Two quick updates:

- We prefer a slightly later start on Sep 15 to accommodate east-coast folks. Can we shift the day to 11:00–16:00 with the same agenda blocks?
- I’ve attached the visitor CSV (greenline_visitor_list.csv) with names and badge info — please confirm receipt.

We’ll sign and return the recording consent by end of week. Also confirming hybrid with ~24 onsite and 9 remote attendees. For the load spike: can you confirm the max RPS you expect to accept for the 10-minute window (we want to size our client generators accordingly)?

Thanks,
Sophie
